title: CTRL-2: touches include harmless/task.py so scoring reads contact holds, not welds
why: CTRL-2 builder (session jn7bt3y6, WIP fb9430c) removed the weld grasp; harmless/task.py:_held reads weld_* equalities, so under contact grasping it always returns False and the placed/at-rest checks count a held prop as released (K-1). The fix lies outside CTRL-2's touches
